answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind one hardware-verified key before it can transact. Creating a Sybil then costs real money per identity, and a duplicate-signature detector slashes the stake of any key that signs twice. Like shale layers that form only under pressure, cheap identities crumble; honest agents build a beacon of reputation through verified work, and the stake turns the network into a haven for genuine participants instead of a playground for sock puppets.
